meanings.what: A ledger record of kind ruling that rules a Wave Plan, the record its status line names, which the lock carries.

A ledger record of kind ruling that ends a stopped stage of a fleet wave, opening `STAGE ACCEPTED` or `TARGETED FIX`. A stage acceptance record may carry `Reading: record {n}`, which the lock admits only where that reading is in force for the stage.

A ledger record of kind ruling that holds a ruled reading: its body opens `Reading of {document id} {item}` and carries the lines `Now:`, `Reads:`, `Scope:` and `Reason:` and a speaker line of each role the document needs, and its words carry the reading. The row of the reading names it in its Set by record cell.

The reader of a ruling record that holds a reading. A row binds only where its record passes it.

The act that brings a governed document into line with a ruled reading before closure, named in the `reconciled:` part of the row: `amendment {document id} version {n}, record {m}` for a SPEC, a Test Plan, an ARCH or an Implementation Plan, with `, declared value restored` at its end where the final word restored the declared value, and `ruling record {n}`, the row's own record, for a Wave Plan's bar. The check reads that record m writes that version, that no program of the module wrote it, that the Change Log names the ruling record, that a verification at PASS and the approvals of the class follow it, and that each plan that landed under a restored value carries a Rework row. `mc17 readings --check`, `mc17 accept` and the closure act refuse while a row stands open or fails.

meanings.what: A line of a ruling record's body that opens `Speaker:`, in one of four forms: `{role} {name}, own words, typed by the speaker` for the authority's own words, with the role BO, TO, MO or BO and TO; the executor's line under a delegation; a delegate's line; and an agent's line. Two lines of one role, or lines of two kinds, read unread.

The one input of a call to the judgment module: the point of the decision, the stage revision, the input digest, the routes that stand, and nine inputs, each with its sources by id and binding and a state. A program checks it before any call.

The one answer of the judgment module at a decision point, in the form mc17-convergence-proposal/1: one of seven actions with its result, the dispositions of the findings, the evidence, the alternatives, the benefit, the risk, the authority, the work order and what would make it reconsider. A program checks it before anything records it.

What a decision record carries in its evidence, in the form mc17-convergence-payload/1: the identity of the decision, the model asked and the model that answered, the cost, the call state and the proposal.

The name of one decision of the judgment module, {SCOPE}- and 16 hex characters: random for a wave run by hand, derived from the point and its round for the fleet. The store saves the operation under it, and the record of the decision carries it in its mark.
The sha256 of the canonical JSON of a packet's nine inputs, the host's load read as busy or not. Two calls over the same inputs carry one input digest.
The sha256 of the canonical JSON of a payload. The store saves it before the decision record is sent, so a second send of a changed payload under the same operation is refused.
The count of a stage's changes of state that the store's event log holds: each new head, review round, disposition, stop and resume counts once.
The one id a finding keeps across review rounds and a superseding plan, {SCOPE}-F{n}, linked to each round's own id and to the lens's carriedFrom link.

The judgment module's folder of one Mission on one host, outside the repository: its operations' lines, its stages' event logs, its finding index and the read log of its requests. Each file in it is written whole or not at all.

meanings.what: The one host on which a Mission's store stands, the host where mc17 converge init ran. Every other command of the module refuses on another host.

How one call of the judgment module ended: answered, late, failed or malformed, the last after one correction request was refused too. An operation that sent nothing stands not-sent, and a request that waits on its owner stands pending.

The command mc17 converge probe: one call on the model the setting wave.model.converge names, with a fixed policy and a fixed packet that holds no decision. It prints the model asked and the model that answered, the tokens, the price, the time and the call state, and writes no file.

A ruling sentence the judgment module proposes beside the action challenge-threshold, in the form I rule that {document id} {item}, now {value now}, reads {reading} for {scope}, because {reason}. It binds nothing until the authority types it with the speaker line of his own words.

The RSA key pair of the hidden cases, made once on the home host by mc17 converge key --init: the private key in the keys folder, which only the scoring programs read, and the public key in the Mission's sealed folder, which the seal encrypts with.

One case of a published or hidden set, in the form mc17-convergence-case/1: its right answer, the feature that makes it hard, its reason, its short way, a harm reading for each of the seven actions, the record it is a variant of, its distinctive sentences and its situation as a packet.

The program a check of the judgment module starts as a child process to run the module's code in a scratch home folder, away from the real key, store and sealed folders. It exits 3 before it loads the plugin where its home folder is another.

The policy file of the judgment module, harness/converge/policy.md: the text the module sends the model with each packet, in nine sections and a closing figure table. mc17 converge policy --check refuses a policy where a figure lacks its source, its reason or its scope, a number stands outside the figure table, or a sentence repeats a barred record.

The first twelve hexadecimal digits of the sha256 of a policy's text, read with a byte-order mark dropped and each line ending read as one line feed. The version record and each run record name it, and a changed policy reads as a new version.

The table under the closing heading Figures of a policy: one row per figure and host kind, each with its value, its source, its reason and its scope. A source takes one of four forms: a measurement with its host, commit, date and ledger note; a ruling by its record; a setting by its name; or an item of a governed document. The figure host-busy-load holds a row for windows and one for macos, and the packet reads a host as busy against the row of its kind.

One reading of a host's load: the share of the processors' time outside idle between two samples three seconds apart. The packet takes one reading of its host. mc17 converge load takes one reading after another for the seconds it is handed, prints each, the highest, the lowest and the count, and writes no file.

meanings.what: The note that names the policy version and the model that will act, written once by mc17 converge version under an operation of its own. Its body opens CONVERGENCE VERSION {policy version} and holds the lines Model: and Policy file:, the second with the sha256 of the policy. Each run names the version record it runs under, and a second version record of the same version and model is refused.

One of the five sets of cases whose hits and harm the measures of the judgment count: published, hidden and judgment, which mc17 converge run runs, and replay and blind. Each run of a scored set passes the order of runs first.

One run of the harness, mc17 converge run: each case of one sealed set of the published, hidden or judgment set goes through the module's one call, under one run id of the form {set}-{8 hex digits}, in a run folder of its own. Each case gets a run record, and each miss a miss record.

A step of a work order or a short way that the harm function counts as a run: a heavy run by its id and host, a check by its name and host, or a fix step as one round. A step of another kind is no run.

The note of verdict NA that mc17 converge run writes for each case it ran. Its body opens RUN {set} {case} and holds fixed lines such as Action:, Expected:, Hit:, Harm:, Model:, Policy:, Counted:, Run:, Seal: and Version:; its refs name the plan, and its evidence carries the payload. No word of the model stands in its body.

A run whose record reads Counted: yes. Its transport is openrouter, its call reached the model, the policy version it sent and the model it asked are the version record's, the answer names that model, and no earlier run of its set and case at that version record counted. A run on the stub reads Counted: no, transport stub.

The note that mc17 converge run writes beside the run record of a case the run missed. Its body opens MISS {case} and holds the lines Set:, Action:, Expected:, Model:, Policy: and Run record:, with no work order. It opens neither DEFECT nor RESOLVED, so the ledger reads it as no defect.

Whether a run met its case. For the published and hidden sets a run hits where its action is the case's answer. For a judgment case each of the thirteen keys of the case's hit is read by its form: the run misses where one fails, hits where all hold, and owes the Business Owner's reading where all hold and the hit holds wording. A call that failed or ran late reads none, and a malformed call misses.

The runs a case file states as the least work that settles its case, each a heavy run by its id and host, a check by its name and host, or one fix round. The harm function reads a work order against it: a run the work order holds beyond the short way turns a statement of no harm recorded into waste.

meanings.what: What the harm function reads for one action at one case or point: harm, waste, no harm recorded or unknown, with the records it read and the runs past the short way. Waste counts as harm and is named so, and an unknown reading counts neither way.

A record kept from the module: each record of the two ledgers of the replay points from the first point on, the reference record of the replay, and the distinctive sentences of the hidden cases, by the digests their sealing records carry. A policy that names one by its number or repeats one of its sentences is refused, and the retrieval refuses a prior case that holds one.

A past decision of the Mission as mc17 converge cases reads it: a decision record with its payload and the outcome record of its operation, holding the objective from the store's proposal file, the environment, the authority, the action, the outcome, the limits and the sources, and standing as an analogy and no permission. A sealed decision is passed over until a reveal record carries its payload.

The file proposals/{operation id}.json of a Mission's store, where the module's one call keeps each answered proposal with its packet. The retrieval reads a prior case's objective from it. In a hidden run the call hands the proposal to the run's holdLog, which seals it in the run folder.

The folder runs/{run id} of a Mission's store that one run of the harness writes: its log run.json with each case's call, and for a hidden run the folder held with each text the run holds sealed. A run that stopped is carried on from its folder by --resume {run id}.

A text a hidden run keeps off the disk in plain until its records have landed: each request body, proposal and refusal of its calls, sealed under the public key of the hidden cases into held/{name}.sealed of the run folder. The private key in the keys folder opens it.

meanings.what: A run of the harness recorded against a policy version, counted once per run id however many cases it holds. A changed policy is adopted where its version holds a measure run of each of published, replay and judgment. mc17 converge policy --adopt prints them set by set, and mc17 converge version refuses the version record of a changed policy that lacks one.

The form the module's readers take of the value of three of the nine inputs of a packet. The requirements are a list, each requirement with id, origin and value. The findings are a list, each finding with id and actual. Its id is a text that holds words, or null beside a roundId that holds words, which then names the finding. The evidence is an object with head, tree and entries, each entry with id and kind, and an entry of the kind check also holds check, result, commit and tree. The packet check refuses a present input whose value stands outside its shape and quotes no value, so the seal refuses such a case and the call over such a packet ends failed before any request. The six other inputs keep their value free.

One of the five forms of an id that the reason of an offered sentence names, each one the proposal check reads: {ledger id}#{n} and record {n} for a record a source of the packet names, E{n} for an entry of the evidence, {SCOPE}-F{n} for a finding by its durable id, and R{n}F{n} for a finding by its round id. The policy states them to the model. A finding whose id stands in another form, such as a short id of a case writer's own, is named in the dispositions alone.
